notes.title: Bloodbound Overhaul Incoming – Huge Changes Ahead!
notes.content:
Hey Bloodbound community, we’ve got some massive news! We are officially overhauling Bloodbound with a ton of improvements, new content, and exciting features. While we don’t have an exact release date just yet, we’re aiming to launch before summer!

What’s Coming in the Overhaul?
Level Reworks & Optimization – More polished environments with improved visuals and performance.
New Map: The Farm – A terrifying new battleground where Slayers and Vampires fight for survival.
Finishers – Brutal execution moves to end your enemies in style.
Modding Support – A Level Editor so you can create and share your own maps.
New Game Modes – Expanding beyond the current experience with fresh, exciting modes. More details soon.
Leveling System & Unlockable Titles – Earn XP and level up to unlock unique titles that showcase your progress and skill.
New Lobby System & Menu – A smoother, more immersive experience before the hunt begins.
Battle Pass – Earn in-game currency (Fangs) to unlock weapon skins, player skins, and more.
Improved Animations – Smoother, more responsive character movements for an even better gameplay experience.
And more!

Bloodbound is Going Free-to-Play!
We know the player base isn’t as active as we’d like, and we want more people to experience Bloodbound. So, with this overhaul, Bloodbound will officially go free-to-play!

A Huge Thank You to Our Supporters!
To everyone who purchased Bloodbound during its alpha phase—we cannot thank you enough. Your support has allowed us to make this overhaul a reality. As a token of our appreciation, all early supporters will receive:

Exclusive Cosmetics – Only available to alpha supporters.
2,000 Fangs – In-game currency to spend on customization.
A Legendary Title – Show off your early support in style.
How to Claim Your Rewards?
Simply log into the game before the overhaul drops, and they’re yours!

This is a huge step forward for Bloodbound, and we can’t wait for you to experience the changes. Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Bloodbound VLOG 0.5.3- Improving our Levels
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=0JA6JO_qDSU;full][/previewyoutube]

**Bloodbound 0.5.3 Update**

- **Coding Optimization**: We've made several optimizations to improve overall game performance and reduce load times.
  
- **Removed Self-Names**: Player names are no longer visible to themselves, enhancing the game's focus on teamwork and strategy.

- **Team Deathmatch (TDM) Improvements**:
  - **Fixed Team Change Spawn Bug**: Resolved an issue where players would not spawn after switching teams in TDM.
  - **Improved Spawn Points**: Updated spawn points to prevent players from spawning in areas where the opposing team is camping, reducing spawn kills.
  - **No Points for Self-Kills**: Killing yourself no longer adds points to the enemy team.
  
- **Map Updates**:
  - **Bloodave Performance Boost**: Bloodave map received a significant performance upgrade. We've reduced texture sizes for better memory performance and added shadows for a more immersive experience.
  - **Invisible Tris Removal**: Removed invisible tris on Bloodave for smoother gameplay.

- **New Animations**:
  - **Inspect Animations Added**: Added inspect animations for Jill's pistol, Lisa's knife, Vampire hands, all stakes (work in progress), Pablo's shotgun, and all Slayer stakes.

- **General Fixes**:
  - **Ammo Box Duplication**: Fixed an issue where ammo boxes would spawn twice for clients.
  - **Vampire Bot Visibility**: Vampire bots will no longer become invisible after being killed.
  - **Vampire Heart Hitbox**: The hitbox for the Vampire heart is now correctly attached to the heart, fixing the issue where it would float when Vampires were downed.
  - **Slayer Body Persistence**: Slayer bodies now remain on the map for 5 minutes, providing Vampires with a strategic advantage throughout the rounds, especially in TDM.
  - **Crouching When Dead**: Players can no longer crouch when dead as a Slayer.
  - **Crash Fixes**: Addressed crashes occurring when players were killed by bots.
  - **Main Menu Button Fix**: Corrected the main menu button redirects for smoother navigation.

notes.title: Bloodbound Update Patch Notes 0.5.2
notes.content:
[b]Bloodbound Update Patch Notes[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41248264/b2a86b5908f27ece15dd849c01a31db0804768af.png[/img]

[b]New Features:[/b]
- Leaderboards Activated:** Leaderboards now work, allowing players to track their progress and compete for the top spot!
- **Fangs Collected Reset:** Added a clear fangs collected option to the main menu for easier tracking.

[b]Gameplay Changes:[/b]
- **Ammo Management:** Ammo will now automatically despawn after 5 minutes, reducing visual clutter and improving gameplay performance.
- **Slayer Adjustments:** 
  - **Sprint Cost Reduced:** Slayers can now sprint more efficiently, allowing for better maneuverability during combat.
  - **Stake Damage Increased:** It now takes only 7 hits to kill a vampire with full health, down from 10. This makes slayers more formidable against their undead foes.
  - **Rider Fire Delay Reduced:** The delay for firing as a Rider has been decreased, making for faster and more reactive combat.

[b]Visual and UI Improvements:[/b]
- **Malissa Blood Vision Fix:** The grayscale effect from Malissa’s blood vision no longer carries over to the next round when used at the last minute.
- **HUD and UI Fixes:**
  - Removed HUD hits during map votes to prevent mouse glitches.
  - Map vote UI now displays map names for easier selection.
- **Name Tag Enhancements:** Name tags have been optimized for performance and responsiveness, and are now visible in Team Death Match. Additionally, bot names can now be seen.
- **Cosmetic Adjustments:** Blood Avenue has been adjusted for improved cosmetic presentation.

[b]Map and Performance Optimization:[/b]
- **Map Performance:** Optimized Blood Avenue, Cemetery, and Club for better performance, resulting in smoother gameplay experiences.
- **Particle Effects:** Removed blood particles spawning on player spawn and implemented a more efficient method for preloading particle effects.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- **FOV Issues Fixed:** Fixed Field of View (FOV) issues affecting Lisa Slayer to ensure a consistent gameplay experience.
- **Lens Flare and Chromatic Aberration Settings:** Resolved issues where settings were resetting unexpectedly.

notes.title: Bloodbound 0.5.1 Buddy Vision and More
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41248264/24138a178dd207ce04f4a99974cd0a19de8f3df1.png[/img]

Today, we are excited to dive into a brand-new feature that we believe will be a true game-changer in Bloodbound. Introducing *Buddy Vision* in update 0.5.1! With this feature, you'll now have the ability to see your teammates at all times, even when they’re out of sight or behind walls. This was designed to enhance your awareness of the battlefield, because in Bloodbound, teamwork is absolutely crucial.


But that’s not all—Slayers also benefit from seeing ammo box drops around the map, highlighted with a subtle glow to make them easier to spot in our notoriously dark environments. Speaking of darkness, we’ve brightened up our levels slightly to balance the fast-paced gameplay. We realized that while vampires thrive in the shadows, Slayers needed a bit more visual clarity to even the odds, especially now that vampires have more agility with their new leaping abilities.

Patch Notes
[list]
[*] Flashlight Audio: Flashlights now emit sounds for added immersion.
[*] Flashlights Turn Off on Death: Flashlights will now automatically turn off when a player dies.
[*] TDM Bot Spawning: Resolved an issue where bots would sometimes overlap upon spawning. You can now spawn without being overlapped by another bot.
[*] TDM Bot-Free Spawn: Players can now spawn in TDM mode without the presence of an opposing bot.
[*] Rehost Glitch Fixed: Addressed an issue where players were unable to rehost after hosting a server.
[*] Menu Background Video: Fixed a bug where the menu background video would rapidly replay.
[*] Mid-Game Character Swap: When re-selecting a character mid-game in TDM, you will now instantly die and respawn as the new character.
[*] Outlines: Fixed outline rendering issues.
[*] Texture Blooming: Corrected excessive blooming on textures for a better visual experience.
[*] Taunt Bug Fix: Taunts no longer get stuck on clients, and you can no longer taunt when a vampire is down.
[*] Fall Damage: Slayers can now die from fall damage, which has been adjusted to a reasonable level.
[*] TDM Character Menu: Fixed an issue where the character selection menu would get stuck when choosing a vampire.
[*] Cancel Button in TDM: Added a cancel button on the character selection screen in TDM, preventing instant kills that could ruin your score.
[*] Vampire Vision Fix: Vampire vision no longer transfers to the Slayer team when a player changes teams.
Ability Durations:
[*] Malissa: Increased the duration of Malissa's ability.
[*] Eric: Increased the duration of Eric's ability.
[/list]

notes.title: Bloodbound 0.5.0 is out!
notes.content:
What’s up, Stakeheads?  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41248264/d450862144a9d322ada7c826cbd04fe5658bfad3.jpg[/img]

We’re thrilled to announce the release of Bloodbound 0.5! Our team has been hard at work making improvements and adding new content, and we can’t wait for you to experience it all.

**First off, a huge thank you** for your ongoing support and feedback! It’s been invaluable in helping us shape the game. Now, let’s dive into what’s new:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41248264/939c0aaf744588d9ff8955969fd63c0ba8967a73.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41248264/438a0121fa247dbd31badf9a2a9ee5e0b41fe922.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41248264/5332d2e1c24891ae5027b5d3ac3c4c9f6f52c0ea.jpg[/img]

**Introducing the new map: Lair.**  
This face-to-face battleground takes place in Eric’s lair—a bloody, intense arena filled with awesome props. It’s also our most optimized map to date. Our level designer has put in a lot of work learning from previous experiences to ensure top-notch performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41248264/e7b82e9dee11933cd956a49ee9bd416facd62b76.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41248264/a26f74c5b1fc742f8305172ac084e538020a6dfe.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41248264/9422f1b6dbbc4bd98a3296c77890752223e264d5.jpg[/img]

**Farmhouse has been temporarily removed,** but don’t worry—it’s coming back soon with massive improvements. We’re rebuilding it from the ground up with updated assets and visuals to enhance your gameplay experience.

**Vampire mechanics have also been reworked.**  
Previously, leaping vampires could only move forward, but now, you can veer slightly to the left or right during a leap, or even interrupt it if you find yourself diving headfirst into a group of slayers. We’ve also improved the network synchronization and reduced rubber banding for a smoother experience.

**In 0.5, we’ve removed Easy Anti Cheat** to make way for our upcoming map editor plugin, which will give you the freedom to create and share your own levels. We can’t wait to see the amazing battlegrounds you come up with!

**We’ve made some other key changes as well:**  
-The main menu has been revamped, and the in-game currency has been removed. Skins and taunts can now only be earned by playing the game;
- We’ve improved stability in the menu and ensured that game modes are now accurately selected.

**Looking ahead, here’s what’s on the horizon:**  
- The Farmhouse map will be relaunched with its new enhancements;
- We’re continuing to work on finishers and plan to roll them out soon;
- Controller support is in the works for those who prefer playing with gamepads;
- We’re developing a new game mode called “Protect the Master” where both teams will need to protect their master.

Protect the Master is a game mode where one member of your team is randomly chosen to become the Master. If you're on the vampire side, the Master transforms into a powerful vampire with enhanced speed and agility. On the slayer side, the Master gains extra health and wields a more powerful weapon. The primary objective for your team is simple: protect your Master at all costs.

Thank you again for your continued support. We’re still very much alive, and we can’t wait to see you in-game!

notes.title: BloodBound Version 0.4.30 Update Notes
notes.content:
Greetings, BloodBound players! We're excited to bring you the latest update, version 0.4.30, packed with adjustments to enhance your gaming experience. Here's a rundown of the key changes:

[b]Balancing Changes:[/b]

Pablo's Secondary Speed: We've made adjustments to Pablo's secondary speed to ensure a more balanced gameplay experience.

Rider's Secondary Cooldown: We've heard your feedback! The Rider's secondary ability cooldown has been reduced, allowing for more strategic and fluid gameplay.

Rider's ADS Walk Movement: To fine-tune the Rider's performance, we've reduced movement speed during ADS (Aim Down Sights) walking.

[b]Map Tweaks for TDM:[/b]

Farmhouse and Club Spawn Points: In Team Deathmatch (TDM), spawn points on the Farmhouse and Club maps have been strategically spaced out. This change aims to prevent predictable spawn patterns, adding an extra layer of challenge and excitement to your matches.

[b]Vampiric Adjustments:[/b]

No Crouching When Dead or Weak: Vampires will no longer automatically crouch when dead or weakened. This alteration provides a smoother transition in the afterlife without affecting your mobility.

These changes are crafted with your feedback and gameplay in mind, aiming to create a more enjoyable and dynamic experience in the world of BloodBound. As always, your input is invaluable, so keep the feedback coming, and we'll continue working to make BloodBound the best it can be.

Thank you for being a part of the BloodBound community! Get ready for an even more thrilling adventure in version 0.4.30!

Greetings, fearless vampire hunters! We're thrilled to bring you the latest update for our game, packed with exciting features and enhancements. Here's what you can expect in version 0.4.20:

[b]1. Server Reset Mechanism:[/b]

In empty servers with bots, if the cap limit is exceeded upon a player's entrance, the server will now automatically reset. Keep the action intense and fair, even when the stakes are high!

[b]2. Father Mercy's Fiery Arsenal:[/b]

Father Mercy has embraced the power of fire! His torch now unleashes a short-range fireball, causing damage to vampires in its path. What's more, vampires struck by the torch will suffer additional burn damage. Father Mercy is ready to light up the night and protect humanity like never before!

Father Mercy's special ability, the Holy Cloud, has received a stunning visual update. A divine cloud now envelops him, creating an awe-inspiring spectacle. Watch as the cloud gracefully fades away when the ability is no longer active. Get ready for a heavenly experience!

Pablo has a brand-new bat skin available in the shop! Featuring a bat stained with the blood of countless vampires, this skin tells the tale of relentless battles against the forces of darkness. Stand out on the battlefield with this unique and striking Pablo-themed creature.

The Shop is now open for business! Explore a plethora of customization options as you unlock or purchase stunning skins and taunts. Let your unique style shine on the battleground.

[h3]2. Vamp Fangs Rewards: Earn Your Stripes![/h3]
Engage in more rewarding battles with the introduction of Vamp Fangs. Earn these coveted rewards for every kill and, to a lesser extent, for each death. Embrace the thrill of the hunt and reap the bloodthirsty bonuses!

[h3]3. In-Game Taunts: Mock and Dominate![/h3]
Taunts have joined the arsenal! Unleash in-game taunts to mock your foes and assert your dominance. Unlock a variety of taunts in the store, adding a new layer of expression to your victories.

[h3]4. Streamlined Inventory Access: Equip with Ease![/h3]
Enjoy seamless management of your unlockables with the newly added inventory in the main menu. Equip your favorite skins and taunts effortlessly and prepare for battle in style.

[h3]5. Weekly Additions to the Collection: Fresh Content Every Week![/h3]
Currently, unlock an exciting array of skins and taunts, with more additions coming every week. Stay tuned for a constant infusion of fresh content to keep your collection vibrant and diverse.

[h3]6. Leaderboard Limitations: Rise to the Top 15![/h3]
The competition is fierce as the leaderboard now showcases the top 15 players per class. Will you ascend to the pinnacle of your class and etch your name in Bloodbound history?

[h3]7. Enhanced Stability: A Smoother Gameplay Experience![/h3]
We've worked diligently to improve game stability. Experience smoother gameplay with fewer disruptions, allowing you to focus on the thrill of battle without interruptions.
Thank you for being a vital part of the Bloodbound community. We hope you enjoy these updates, and as always, stay tuned for more exciting content on the horizon. May your victories be legendary, and your fangs razor-sharp!

notes.title: Game Version 3.65 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Chat Enhancements:

Resolved the issue where clicking into the chat on the server score caused interruptions.

The new spectator mode no longer relies on mouse input, providing a smoother experience for spectators.

Added graphics improvements such as NVIDIA DLSS, AMD FSR2, NVIDIA Reflex, and a complete video option overhaul with more customization choices.

notes.title: Bloodbound!
notes.content:
[b]Sketchy Realms[/b] here, a Vampire versus Slayer Multiplayer gaming experience, is now almost on the verge of completion. Since the start of this project, we’ve been heavily inspired by so many different vampire culture influences from ancient history, myths, movies, comics, and also other popular cult classics. We have seriously taken the time well thought about this project. With great research, we’ve used various types of vampire lore in order to ensure our game reflects the dark and macabre of the supernatural for our players. 7 years have come and gone just through experimenting with the [b]Unreal Engine 4[/b] alone. The transformations, time investment, and efforts this project has undergone will not go in vain. This team has passionately poured so much love into this project over the number of years. And for these very reasons, the [b]Sketchy Realms Team[/b] would like to proudly announce our new invocation. The Community has spoken, and we’ve listened. 

About 300 members voted unanimously toward a name change. Since expectations have been rising, so has our direction. Finalizing a decision, we now venture into making big changes to our game to best provide more lore, new maps, and other fresh content to get your bloody hands on. We are now in this together, we are Officially [b]Bloodbound![/b] This has been something the team has been debating about possibly doing a few years back. Initially, it was ultimately decided upon, mainly due to the fact that we are respectfully choosing to expand our creative freedom in our vampire universe from here on out. Everything that you have seen over the past few years has gone through a complete overhaul of transformations. We as a community decided this would be the best course of action in order to clarify our new path. Alongside this rebranding you are about to witness, not just a name change, but also additional new features which we’ll dive deeper into in a moment after the lists of where our project currently resides.

Current Status

[b]Developer Notes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Character model meshes have been completely updated 
[*] General performance increased in most maps
[*] Melee and ranged weapons have been improved and updated
[*] Weapons are more responsive
[*] LOD on Characters
[*] Door functionality added
[*] Added name tags and only teammates may see each other’s names
[*] New Lobby System
[*] New Menu Design
[*] Brutal Finisher system implemented
[/list]

The bloodbath is about to get started. Sketchy Realms is currently smoothing out the final touches toward its release. The team understands that there are people eagerly waiting upon Bloodbound’s release. Fret not, you may not have to wait for long…


[b]Steamfest[/b], a celebration of upcoming games is coming! We’ve been busy preparing for February’s upcoming multi-day events. There you can find us, showcasing all of our latest added features and gameplay. We are also going to be revealing various classified information we’ve been holding onto for such festivities. On that note, we’ll be releasing a vlog entailing where we are as [b]Bloodbound[/b] along with fresh new content. You better be there! See you soon at [b]Steamfest[/b] and don’t forget to Wishlist us at: https://store.steampowered.com/app/909750/

We are [b]Sketchy Realms[/b], and although we are a small group, this is a labour of love for us that continues expanding. If you like what we do, support us and catch up to early bird content here! [url=https://www.patreon.com/sketchyrealms]Patreon[/url]
